REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52581  Recommendation to approve the minutes for Board of Examiners, Appeals and
  Condemnation of Monday, December 11, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-52569  Recommendation to conclude the hearing and determine that the subject properties
  located at 1551-1565 Santa Fe Avenue, Long Beach, CA, meet the definition of
  vacant lots as stated in the Long Beach Municipal Code 18.29.070(C), the appellant
  is the owner of the properties and uphold the annual administering fee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-52571  Recommendation to conclude the hearing and determine that the subject property
  located at 2223 E. Artesia Blvd, Long Beach, CA, meet the definition of vacant lots
  as stated in the Long Beach Municipal Code Section 18.29.070(C), the appellant is
  the owner of the properties and uphold the annual administering fee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Board of Examiners, Appeals and Condemnation on non-agenda items.
Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS
